takeaways: Time spent searching for files is a structural cost; a cowork engine should assemble context and deliver decision-ready artifacts instead of search results.
A curated context layer of authoritative sources, plus governance through Entra ID permissions, sensitivity labels and Purview, is the foundation for trustworthy autonomous work.
Measure the shift with time to decision and rework rate, starting with one high-frequency workflow as a baseline.
hook: Knowledge workers still lose hours every week hunting for the right file, and putting a chat window on top of the mess only makes it faster. This episode is for IT leaders and architects planning Microsoft 365 Copilot beyond the chat assistant. Learn how a Copilot cowork engine with curated context, built-in governance and memory turns search into decision-ready work.
